Flagship Applications & Specifications

Web Application v0.1.7

ROM Manager

A client-side web application ("mp3tag for retro games") that organizes your ROM collection using the File System Access API. Groups variants by DAT hash matching (No-Intro / Redump), attaches cover art, and manages local metadata with zero server upload.

Engine Specs SDK

// Technical Principles

Built for Performance & Privacy

Audio-Clocked Frame Loop

No ASYNCIFY bloat or emulated GL. Frame pacing is driven by AudioWorklet ring buffers (~90ms queued), locking emulator speed precisely to audio hardware with zero pitch drift.

100% Client-Side Privacy

Your games and files stay on your machine. Using WebAssembly and the File System Access API, zero ROM bytes or user telemetry are ever uploaded to an external server.

Unified Engine SDK Contract

All engines conform to @wasm-gaming/engine-specs. Switch between Snes9x, mGBA, FBNeo, or RSDKv4 without changing host application control code.

Dynamic Asset Mounting

Engines do not bake game data into WASM binaries. Hosts supply game ROMs or Data.rsdk files dynamically into Virtual Filesystems (VFS/OPFS) at runtime.
